scenes.heading: Open a separate account before your first client

sents.d: Open a separate account before your first client
Before your first paying client, give your coaching money its own account.
Clean records make tax time far easier.
And you can see clearly whether your coaching business is actually making money.
Open an account just for coaching payments and business costs.
Set aside part of each payment for taxes, and ask an accountant how much.

take: Keep business money separate from day one, and set some aside for taxes.
